title: Motorola Just Made a $1,600 Phone. Wait, MOTOROLA? 😳
description:
Motorola wants $1,600 for a phone — and it's on sale in the US today. 😳

The Motorola Signature 27 packs a 7,000 mAh battery (typical), a 200 MP periscope zoom camera, up to 12,000 nits of peak brightness (Motorola claim), a Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and seven years of OS upgrades. US price: $1,599.99 (12 GB / 512 GB, unlocked) at Motorola.com, Amazon and Best Buy from November 26.

The catch: in Europe the same 12/512 GB phone is listed at €1,899 in Germany, Austria, Spain, Portugal and France — but €1,399 in Italy, Belgium and Ireland. That's a €500 gap.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 58/100 → SPEC. Grab it if battery life matters most to you.

Spec or wreck? Tell us below.
